approach.summary: Promote strict writing-helper acceptance into retained release evidence and make `scripts/release_check_summary.py` treat that evidence as a blocking same-HEAD signal before it can emit `Decision: GO`.
key_points: Keep execution ownership in the existing PowerShell acceptance script and reusable workflow instead of teaching the summary script to start gateways or rerun Windows-only checks.
Add a structured acceptance artifact under `.workflow/evidence/release/` with at least `status`, `strict`, `generated_at`, `head_sha`, case counts, and any failed-case artifact linkage.
Extend `scripts/release_check_summary.py` with a blocking `writing_helper_acceptance_signal` that fails when the artifact is missing, not strict, for a different HEAD, or records a failing run.
Lock the new contract with delivery-gate anchors, regression tests, and sign-off docs so the blind spot cannot regress silently.
non_goals: Do not redesign `.github/workflows/external-release-gate.yml`; it already models writing-helper acceptance as a blocking gate through the reusable workflow.
Do not add dynamic execution logic to `scripts/check_authority_alignment.py`; keep the minimal guardrail in `scripts/delivery_gate.py` and the governance test suite.

rationale: The current false `GO` comes from `scripts/release_check_summary.py` computing the verdict only from its in-process `checks` list, while the real blocking gate lives outside that list.

Making the acceptance gate emit a retained artifact is the smallest change that aligns local sign-off, retained evidence, and reusable CI proof without duplicating the Windows gateway flow inside the summary script.
Requiring `strict=true` and `head_sha == git rev-parse HEAD` prevents stale or non-blocking acceptance evidence from being reused for a newer release snapshot.

tasks.title: Emit retained writing-helper acceptance evidence
tasks.description: Extend `scripts/check-writing-helper.ps1` to write a structured JSON artifact such as `.workflow/evidence/release/writing-helper-acceptance.json` on both pass and fail, including strict-mode flag, current HEAD SHA, totals, failed-case linkage, and generated timestamp. Update `.github/workflows/writing-helper-acceptance.yml` to preserve that artifact as release evidence on success and failure.

tasks.title: Make release summary decision consume acceptance evidence
tasks.description: Add a helper in `scripts/release_check_summary.py` that loads and validates the acceptance artifact, converts it into a blocking `writing_helper_acceptance_signal`, and includes that signal in the markdown summary plus `.workflow/evidence/release/release-readiness-artifact.json`. The signal must fail on missing artifact, non-strict runs, mismatched HEAD, parse errors, or recorded acceptance failure.

tasks.title: Harden contract docs and regressions
tasks.description: Update `docs/release/SIGN_OFF.md` so the consolidated snapshot explicitly depends on the strict same-HEAD acceptance artifact. Add delivery-gate anchors and governance tests that require the new blocking signal and artifact reference in `scripts/release_check_summary.py`. Keep `scripts/check_authority_alignment.py` unchanged unless reviewers require it to mention the new artifact path.

dependencies: Implementation is independent of ISS-20260414-001, but a full green-path `Decision: GO` validation still depends on that issue because strict writing-helper acceptance currently fails on this HEAD.
validation: Start the authoritative gateway, then run `./scripts/check-writing-helper.ps1 -Strict -Port 18080 -Host 127.0.0.1` and verify `.workflow/evidence/release/writing-helper-acceptance.json` is written with `strict: true` and the current HEAD SHA.
Run `python scripts/release_check_summary.py` and confirm `release-check-summary.md` plus `.workflow/evidence/release/release-readiness-artifact.json` include `writing_helper_acceptance_signal`.
Negative check: with the acceptance artifact missing, stale, non-strict, or failed, `python scripts/release_check_summary.py` must emit `Decision: NO_GO`.
Positive check after ISS-20260414-001 is fixed: rerun strict acceptance and confirm the summary can return `Decision: GO` only when the acceptance artifact passes for the current HEAD.
